name: CoinGecko Public API
summary: Cryptocurrency prices, market caps, volumes and history for thousands of coins; works keyless at a low rate limit.
description: Prices, market data, OHLC, exchanges, trending coins and metadata for 15,000+ coins. The legacy public endpoint works without a key at low limits; a free Demo key (signup, no card) gives a more stable 30 calls/minute. Historical depth on the free tier is limited to 365 days.

auth.notes: Keyless works on api.coingecko.com. A free Demo key can be sent as the x-cg-demo-api-key header or the x_cg_demo_api_key query parameter.

rate_limit.summary: Keyless public access is tight and shared (roughly 5-15 calls/minute per the research, subject to change, may return 429). A free Demo key gives 30 calls/minute and 10,000 calls/month.

license.name: Free with attribution to CoinGecko required on the public free plan

coverage.geographic: Global crypto markets; free history limited to 365 days

agent_notes: Coins are addressed by CoinGecko ids (for example bitcoin), not tickers; look them up via the /search endpoint. Prefer a free Demo key over keyless access, which is throttled hard. Responses are cached for a minute or few.
caveats: Keyless limits are tight and may change.
Commercial use and attribution rules apply.
Free-tier history is capped at 365 days.
